speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand the cause of your symptoms, how would you describe the nature and location of this severe leg pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). The combination of fever, bruising (suggesting thrombocytopenia), fatigue (anemia), and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old is highly characteristic of ALL, specifically involving the long bones. I will now request a complete blood count with differential and peripheral smear to confirm the presence of blast cells. REQUEST TEST: CBC_with_differential_and_peripheral_smear. REQUEST IMAGES: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy.
